meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装上个人微信频道:用腾讯官方 iLink Bot API,手机扫码登录,靠长轮询实时收发消息,不需要公网 webhook,也不用付费 token,不违反腾讯服务条款。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入个人微信(而非企业微信或公众号)时,这个技能接手:复制微信适配器、装依赖、扫码登录,再把微信消息接到某个 agent group。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw,我要扫码登录
say.note: 先复制适配器、装依赖,再启动服务打印二维码

say.text: 微信登录好了,把这个微信会话接到我的 agent group 上
微信提示 session expired,帮我重新扫码登录

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw via Tencent's official iLink Bot API: you log in by scanning a QR code, and messages are received over long-polling. No public webhook and no paid token needed.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw (not WeCom or Official Account): it copies in the adapter, installs the client, walks through QR login, then wires the WeChat chat to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat to NanoClaw, I'll scan the QR code
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, restarts to print the QR

say_en.text: WeChat is logged in, wire this WeChat chat to my agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to pick the agent group

say_en.text: WeChat says session expired, help me re-scan to log in
